primer: Intuitive Surgical (NASDAQ: ISRG) leads global soft-tissue robotic surgery . As of September 30, 2026, it runs 12,094 da Vinci systems (+12% YoY) and 1,152 Ion endoluminal systems (+21% YoY) . From FY2016 to FY2025, revenue grew at a 15.7% CAGR from $2.70 billion to $10.06 billion . TTM sales hit $11.58 billion (+20.45% YoY) with a 32.25% operating margin , 18.50% ROIC , and zero debt ($6.80 billion cash and investments at Q3 2026) . Roughly 84% of sales are recurring from single-use tools, accessories, service contracts, and leases .
